Root mean squared error at 96 h
Mean over the standard-Wnt replicates; caudal mesoderm, pre-somitic mesoderm and somite front summed into one part.
At 96 h most error is a split inside paraxial mesoderm: summing it removes 0.15 RMSE on average (Welch)
